o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish اولوم (ölüm). By surface analysis, öl- (“to die”) + -üm.
Internationalism; from French téléphone, from Ancient Greek τῆλε (têle, “afar”) + φωνή (phōnḗ, “voice, sound”).
